abilities.name: drizzle
abilities.effect: Summons rain that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

abilities.name: rain-dish
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/16 max HP after each turn during rain.

hoenn.flavorText: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It acts as a delivery service by carrying small Pokémon in its bill. It bobs on the waves to rest.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

updated-johto.flavorText: It protects its young in its beak. It bobs on waves, resting on them on days when the waters are calm.

original-unova.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

updated-unova.flavorText: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

kalos.flavorText: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Pelipper searches for food while in flight by skimming the wave tops. This Pokémon dips its large bill in the sea to scoop up food, then swallows everything in one big gulp.

original-alola.flavorText: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

updated-alola.flavorText: It scoops up Wishiwashi in its huge beak and swallows them whole. It can devour more than 30 at one go!

swsh.flavorText: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.
